Resident Welfare Associations are widely viewed as one of the most powerful platforms, often a republic unto themselves. But the representatives also realised very quickly that there were limits to the power of being an RWA head. It fell short when compared with political power. A growing trend across Noida, Greater Noida, Gurugram and Delhi, where RWA presidents, federation members and residents’ representatives are stepping into electoral politics.
